item.note: this is a listing of all the chapter-headings of the main texts in the cycle. here there is mention of a section entitled "ma tshang ba kha bskang ba" (this constitutes a fifth bam po, in addition to the main four) and described as having 15 chapters, but without listing them. a new text begins at 5v4 with the title skabs grangs gsal byed skor tshoms kyi mchong.
